businesses.business: Modular space and portable storage rentals

offering_description.value: Rents and sells modular buildings and portable storage units to businesses, schools, and government agencies. It configures units from its fleet and delivers, installs, and removes them through its branch network.

primary_products.value: Modular offices and buildings; portable storage containers; portable office and storage combinations; modular classrooms; temporary clearspan structures

primary_services.value: Modular space and storage rentals; delivery and installation; unit relocation and removal

customer_segment.value: B2B: Construction contractors, manufacturers, retailers, healthcare providers, and private schools; B2G: Public school districts, government agencies, and military installations

end_markets.value: Construction; manufacturing and industrial operations; retail and commercial services; education; government

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Recurring charges for modular buildings, storage units, and add-ons such as furniture and fixtures; service fees: Delivery, installation, relocation, and removal of rented units; product sales: Purchases of new and used modular buildings and storage units
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Acquires, configures, and maintains a fleet of modular buildings and storage units for businesses and public institutions; service provider: Delivers and sets up units at construction sites, commercial properties, schools, and government facilities

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada, and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Modular buildings, portable storage containers, and temporary clearspan structures

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local sales representatives and national account teams; own locations: Company-operated branches that dispatch and service rental units

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State and local building codes, workplace safety rules, and commercial vehicle and oversized-load transport requirements
